findings.behavior: Production composition used a generic package hash and omitted intrinsic fact hashes and nested reference kinds.
findings.repair: Reuse existing research hash domains; check intrinsic facts and kinds without requiring new current-use or transitive authority.

findings.behavior: Small deeply nested malformed manifest input exhausted the recursive parser stack.
findings.repair: Check maximum depth 64 and maximum lexical tokens 100000 in a linear scan before existing recursive parse, duplicate-member and canonical checks.

findings.behavior: Derived DesignVersion reference used a generic hash; calibration facts and dependent commitments used the wrong domain.
findings.repair: Correct derived domains and all downstream commitments; retain original raw packet and expectations with explicit old-new provenance.

findings.behavior: Host context omitted independently expected actor and audience required by the pure approval checker.
findings.repair: Require readonly authority.actor_id and authority.audience using ApprovalReceipt field types; pure host request and approval gates bind the independent expectation.
